title: Team Leader
location: Information Evolution India Private Limited Module No. 002/1 Ground Floor, TIDEL Park Coimbatore Ltd, ELCOSEZ, Coimbatore, 641 014., India
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and guide a team of [15] data processing and scraping specialists. Allocate tasks and projects based on team members' strengths and expertise. Foster a collaborative and innovative team culture that promotes knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Oversee the development and implementation of web scraping and data extraction processes to gather relevant information from online sources. Stay updated on the latest scraping techniques, tools, and technologies to optimize the team's processes. Supervise the team's efforts in cleaning and transforming raw data into structured formats suitable for analysis. Collaborate with data analysts and agents to ensure the processed data meets quality standards and is ready for analysis. Implement quality control measures to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of collected and processed data. Develop and maintain data quality standards and best practices for the team. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, software developers, and project managers, to align data processing efforts with broader organizational goals. Communicate effectively with stakeholders to provide updates on project status, potential challenges, and solutions. Conduct regular performance assessments and provide constructive feedback to team members. Identify training needs and coordinate skill development activities to enhance the team's expertise. Encourage innovative approaches to data processing and scraping techniques, keeping pace with industry trends and advancements. Identify opportunities to streamline processes, increase efficiency, and enhance the team's output quality. Develop project plans, timelines, and milestones for data processing and scraping initiatives. Coordinate with stakeholders to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
